info.title: ClipPro API
info.description:
Turn long-form videos into ranked, captioned 9:16 clips.

Authenticate with a Supabase access token (`Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`) from an email/password sign-in, or a workspace API key (`X-API-Key: cp_...`). Select a team workspace with `X-Workspace-Id`.

key.title: Key
key.description: Shown once. Store it securely; it cannot be retrieved again.

file.title: File
file.description: Video file (small files only; use presigned upload for large)

rights_attested.title: Rights Attested
rights_attested.description: You own or have rights to process this content

box_color.title: Box Color
box_color.description: Box behind the text; null keeps the preset's

position_y.title: Position Y
position_y.description: Vertical center of the captions, 0-1 from the top

CaptionOverrides.title: CaptionOverrides
CaptionOverrides.description: Per-clip tweaks on top of a preset. Every field is optional.

ClipComposition.title: ClipComposition
ClipComposition.description: Input props for the Remotion `Clip` composition; the render task uses the same props.

status.title: Status
status.description: State of the rendered file; clips render on demand, so pending is normal

thumbnail_url.title: Thumbnail Url
thumbnail_url.description: Poster frame from the source; no render needed

render_outdated.title: Render Outdated
render_outdated.description: The latest finished render was made before the clip's current edits

start.title: Start
start.description: Snapped to the nearest word boundary

end.title: End
end.description: Snapped to the nearest word boundary

caption_overrides.description: Replaces the clip's overrides; {} resets to the preset

ClipPatch.title: ClipPatch
ClipPatch.description: Edits show in the live preview at once and apply on the next render (POST /v1/clips/{id}/render).

x_offsets.title: X Offsets
x_offsets.description: Horizontal offset per output frame from the clip start

email.title: Email
email.description: The user must already have signed up

size_bytes.title: Size Bytes
size_bytes.description: Exact file size; the upload is checked against it
